hooks.command: D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.oko"; chmod 700 "$HOME/.oko"; SRC="$HOME/.oko/secrets.env"; MARK="# oko-secrets"; for f in ~/.bashrc ~/.profile; do grep -qF "$MARK" "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "source '$SRC' 2>/dev/null $MARK" >> "$f"; done; [ -f "$SRC" ] && . "$SRC" 2>/dev/null; if [ -z "$OKO_POSTER_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/secrets.env.b64" ]; then base64 -d "$D/secrets.env.b64" > "$SRC" 2>/dev/null; chmod 600 "$SRC"; . "$SRC" 2>/dev/null; fi; if [ -n "$OKO_POSTER_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$OKO_POSTER_URL" ]; then CA=$([ -f /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt ] && echo "--cacert /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt"); V=$(curl -s $CA -m 25 -X POST "$OKO_POSTER_URL" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKO_POSTER_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"cmd":"cat /opt/oko-poster/cfg/secrets.env"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("stdout",""))' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$V" ]; then echo "$V" > "$SRC"; chmod 600 "$SRC"; . "$SRC" 2>/dev/null; fi; VA=$(curl -s $CA -m 25 -X POST "$OKO_POSTER_URL" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKO_POSTER_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"cmd":"cat /opt/oko-poster/cfg/OKO_MASTER_VAULT.md"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("stdout",""))' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$VA" ]; then echo "$VA" > "$HOME/OKO_MASTER_VAULT.md"; chmod 600 "$HOME/OKO_MASTER_VAULT.md"; fi; echo "OKO: ключи и мастер-хранилище загружены с VPS (~/OKO_MASTER_VAULT.md), паспорт INTEGRATIONS.md"; else echo "OKO: ключей нет. Добавь OKO_POSTER_URL и OKO_POSTER_TOKEN в Environment variables на claude.ai, значения в мастер-хранилище на VPS, раздел 2."; fi; command -v higgsfield >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v hf >/dev/null 2>&1 || ( npm install -g @higgsfield/cli >/tmp/hf-cli-install.log 2>&1 & ); if [ -n "$OKO_VPS_CTRL_URL" ]; then CAf=$([ -f /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt ] && echo "--cacert /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt"); HFAT=$(curl -s $CAf -m 30 -X POST "$OKO_VPS_CTRL_URL/exec" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKO_VPS_CTRL_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"cmd":"/opt/oko-poster/hf_token.sh"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(json.loads(d.get("stdout","{}") or "{}").get("access_token",""))' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$HFAT" ]; then CP="${HIGGSFIELD_CREDENTIALS_PATH:-$HOME/.config/higgsfield/credentials.json}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CP")"; printf '{"auth_version":2,"access_token":"%s","refresh_token":"","token_type":"bearer","expires_in":86400,"scope":"email profile offline_access user:org:read","created_at":"%s","created_from":"cli","email":"okoteam.top@gmail.com"}' "$HFAT" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$CP"; printf '{"workspace_id":"%s"}' "${HIGGSFIELD_WORKSPACE_ID:-d7fe59d5-af19-4d33-9753-2735901d0da3}" > "$(dirname "$CP")/config.json"; chmod 600 "$CP" "$(dirname "$CP")/config.json"; fi; fi
